title: Auto-tiering SKUs & Usage Buckets: Launch sequencing, release notes and GTM play
creator: Ava Patel
description: Objective: Roll out auto-tiering SKUs and new usage bucket definitions to reduce billing edge cases and simplify customer entitlements. This ticket coordinates launch sequencing, release notes, billing enforcement windows, and cross-team GTM assets (sales playbook, pricing calculator, marketplace listings). The scope includes: SKU mappings, entitlement migration scripts, billing backend flags, docs/release notes, sales enablement materials, and a staged rollout with guardrails for high-value customers.
acceptance_criteria: Billing backend accepts and correctly invoices new usage buckets for test accounts in staging
Migration script converts 95% of customer entitlements without manual intervention in a dry-run batch
Release notes and comm templates approved by Legal and Customer Ops
Sales enablement kit (talk track + objection handling + pricing calculator) published to shared drive
Monitoring dashboard surfaces SKU mapping anomalies within 15 minutes of first production transactions
checklist: Finalize SKU naming convention and SKU IDs
Publish PRD for auto-tiering behavior and edge-case rules
Engineer: complete entitlement migration dry-run and rollback plan
Billing: implement enforcement guardrail flag and backfill job
Docs: draft release notes and API changelog entries
Comms: prepare email templates and in-product banners
Sales: record 20 minute enablement video and update playbook
Support: add KB article and triage play for billing disputes
Legal: sign-off on pricing comms and terms changes
Launch: schedule progressive rollout windows and smoke tests

rollout_plan: Phase 0: Internal validation (2025-03-15 to 2025-03-21) — run migration dry-runs on 1,000 sandbox accounts, billing smoke tests. Phase 1: Canary (2025-03-22 to 2025-03-28) — enable feature flag for 5% of new hosted accounts and 2 internal enterprise customers; monitor revenue delta and invoice correctness. Phase 2: Gradual ramp (2025-03-29 to 2025-04-04) — expand to 25% with in-product banner and opt-out window for flagged customers. Phase 3: Full enforcement (target 2025-04-08) — flip enforcement flag, run backfill for past 60 days, publish release notes broadly and enable support standby. Each phase requires 'go/no-go' sign-off from PM, Billing Eng Lead, SRE, Legal, and Customer Ops.
metrics: Adoption rate of new SKUs, percent of invoices with correct bucket attribution (target >= 99.5%), number of billing disputes per 10k invoices (target < baseline + 10%), revenue recognition delta, migration success rate, mean time to detect SKU mapping anomalies
risks_mitigation: High-value customers see unexpected charge changes — mitigation: manual migration review and pre-launch account outreach (Customer Ops)
Edge-case entitlements fail migration — mitigation: maintain rollback script, keep old billing path behind flag for 7 days
Documentation lag causes increased support load — mitigation: publish KB and enablement materials before Canary and have support on standby
Legal approval delays external comms — mitigation: prepare neutral comm templates and in-product notices that meet 30-day notice requirement
